name: textical
description: High-Fantasy Tactical RPG Engine with Godot MCP Integration

scripts.godot:version: ts-node -e "const { createGodotMCPServer } = require('./src/mcp-server'); const s = createGodotMCPServer({ projectsPath: './client' }); s.getVersion().then(v => { console.log('Godot Version:', v); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.godot:projects: ts-node -e "const { createGodotMCPServer } = require('./src/mcp-server'); const s = createGodotMCPServer({ projectsPath: './client' }); s.listProjects().then(p => { console.log('Projects:', JSON.stringify(p, null, 2)); process.exit(0); }).catch(e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
